name: We Energies (gas)
notes: Added by the tier-2 reviewer (replaces PGW as a pick: 1.15M gas customers, skipped by the builder without a stated reason). Researched from public we-energies.com pages only (WEC Energy Group, same site structure as Peoples Gas Chicago). My Account and app: checking/savings free; credit/debit card, Google Pay and Apple Pay carry a service fee whose amount is not published (fees.notes; card fee stays the family default). App card limit $2,000 (not expressible; maxPaymentCents must be >= $5,000). Quick Payment (no login), phone (888-823-2943) and walk-in payments all carry an unpublished service fee (fees.notes). Automatic Payment: bank only, free, on the due date, monthly reminder; remove with the remove Automatic Payment link. Paper-free billing: up to 25 months of statements, first paper-free bill about 30 days after sign-up. Payment arrangements self-service online/app 24/7 or 800-842-4565. Stop service: sign in to My Account to request a stop. This is the gas record of a combined gas/electric utility; no electric dossier exists for We Energies. Sign-in identifier and MFA not documented (family defaults).

notes: Credit card, debit card, Google Pay and Apple Pay payments in My Account or the app carry a service fee.
Quick Payment, phone and walk-in payments carry a service fee for every payment method.

help.title: Payment options
paragraphs: In My Account or the We Energies app, paying from a checking or savings account is free; credit card, debit card, Google Pay and Apple Pay payments carry a service fee. Payments post in 1 to 2 business days. In the app, credit card payments are limited to $2,000.

Quick Payment lets you pay without logging in by card, checking, savings, Google Pay or Apple Pay; a service fee applies. Phone payments at 888-823-2943 and walk-in payment locations also carry a service fee; walk-in payments post in 1 to 3 business days.
Mailed payments are free but take 7 to 10 business days on average. Use the envelope that comes with your bill or send payment to We Energies, PO Box 1125, Glenview, IL 60025-8125.

help.title: Automatic Payment
paragraphs: Automatic Payment is free and withdraws your energy bill from the bank account you choose on the due date each month. You get a monthly reminder before the payment is deducted and can keep a paper bill or switch to paper-free billing.
Sign up with Review terms and sign up. If you are already signed up, use the links to update your bank information or remove Automatic Payment.

help.title: Paper-free billing
paragraphs: Paper-free billing lets you view and print up to 25 months of statements online and sends email reminders so you do not miss a payment. Enroll with Review terms and sign up, or use Remove paper-free billing to go back to paper.
Your first paper-free bill arrives on your next billing date, about 30 days after you sign up. You can schedule a payment the day you sign up; payments apply the next business day.

help.title: Payment arrangements and energy assistance
paragraphs: Set up a payment arrangement online or in the We Energies app at any time, with the same terms as calling. The automated line at 800-842-4565 is available 24/7, and representatives answer Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
Customers who cannot pay their energy bill may qualify for Wisconsin or Michigan energy assistance. Budget Billing evens out seasonal swings so bills are more stable month to month.

help.title: Stop service
paragraphs: Sign in to My Account to request a stop in service at an existing address.

Moving within our service area? Residential homeowners and renters can request the move online if none of their previous accounts are past due. Move requests are processed in two business days and confirmed by email.
